items.question: How do I know which post sold tickets?
items.answer: Make a tracked link for each post, promoter or venue. You see visits, bookings and revenue for every link.

items.question: How do guest invite links work?
items.answer: Every guest gets their own link when they book. Friends who book through it are counted to them, and you see it on their record.

items.question: Do I need a WhatsApp Business number?
items.answer: Only for WhatsApp campaigns. Event messages, the push reminder, announcements, follower updates and invite links work without one.

items.question: Who pays for WhatsApp messages?
items.answer: Meta charges for business-started WhatsApp conversations, billed to your WhatsApp Business account at its rates.

items.question: Can guests reply?
items.answer: To campaigns, yes: replies land in your {{brand.name}} inbox and you can answer while WhatsApp’s reply window is open. Announcements are one-way notifications.
